name: labib-tour-management
description: Labib Tour Management System (LTMS) — Enterprise Travel ERP & Booking Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=client && npm run lint:fix --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
